final: SELECT c.category, c.avg_rem, c.total, c.total - o.overall AS above_by FROM (SELECT category, AVG(remaining) AS avg_rem, SUM(amount - spent) AS total FROM budget WHERE amount >= 75 GROUP BY category) c, (SELECT AVG(t) AS overall FROM (SELECT SUM(amount - spent) AS t FROM budget WHERE amount >= 75 GROUP BY category)) o WHERE o.overall IS NOT NULL AND c.total > o.overall ORDER BY c.category
